name: Pager
description: Notification daemon (port of njpatel's omapager, MIT): cards stack and group per source, safe markup, resolved source icons, KDE Connect inline reply, per-source snooze, held notifications, Recent and a disk history, verification-code handling. Do Not Disturb is the dnd flag. Local-first: website icons are fetched only with fetchRemoteIcons

stacking.description: source: a deck per sender; all: one deck for everything

actionsAlign.description: Which end of a card its buttons sit at: right or left

showCountdown.description: Animate the time left along the bottom of the front card (expiry runs either way)

fontScale.description: Card text size in percent of the theme font (75-200); the bar and panel keep theirs

width.description: Card and panel width in px (240-800)

hideSettingsAction.description: Hide the browser's repeated Settings action on web notifications

snoozeDurations.description: Snooze choices: minutes (15, 30, 60, 120, 240, 480) or "tomorrow"; empty uses the default

wakeHour.description: Hour (0-23) that "tomorrow" wakes a source at

sourceLimit.description: Quietened sources listed in the panel (2-20)

recentCount.description: Recent notifications shown in the panel (1-20); memory only, cleared on shell restart

alwaysShow.description: Keep the bar bell visible when nothing is held back or snoozed

codesBypassQuiet.description: Let verification-code notifications through snooze and Do Not Disturb (the panel's key button overrides and is remembered)

smartRaise.description: When a web notification has no window of its own, match its site against browser window titles before opening the site

displayMode.description: active: the focused display for new decks; specific: displayName; all: every display

displayName.description: Output name for displayMode specific (kept while disconnected)

edgeSpacing.description: Gap between the deck and the screen edge / bar, in px (0-64)

avoidFullscreen.description: Never cover a fullscreen window: off, all, or steam (only Steam games); cards go to another display, or wait in Recent

offerSnoozeWhenSharing.description: Offer a timed snooze when portal screen sharing starts (nothing is muted automatically)

fetchRemoteIcons.description: Fetch https://<site>/favicon.ico for web notifications with no local icon. Off by default: it tells the site your IP and when a notification arrived

allowDefaultActionOnCardClick.description: Let a card click invoke the app's default action; off focuses the sender's window or opens the validated source site

historyHours.description: Disk history retention: 0 (off), 1, 24 or 168 hours, at most 100 entries; verification codes are stored redacted

clipboardTimeout.description: Seconds (30, 60 or 90) before a copied code is cleared, if it is still on the clipboard

debugIpc.description: Debug: expose the haseen.pager IPC target (panel state, expand, fold) for smoke tests
